Major Snapshot Release (#1)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40031724/a2b3320bf708558a9c0cbf63fb6c77b91feb1baf.png
The REAL first (technically second) Snapshot build is here! This update will introduce you to a new major region of in the game! This Snapshot features more story with a new chapter. This chapter starts off with the leading act: Perel, Act I: "A Tale of Drought and Fear", where Cardbot starts his quest and travels to his first dimension to explore.

This update takes place in a brand new Dimension: Nightscorched Dimension, Perel. This eerie realm features many odd encounters and dark places to explore. There are also new enemies and weapons for you to find as well. This update includes a new main story quest with all three acts available, as well as an interlude story quest. You can also find up to three new side quests, and two new region quests as well. Region Quests are a new type of quest that can change the environment of the current region by the end.

notes.title: Major Snapshot Release (#0)
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40031724/c2cca778d7ee3a23db3797280c3b10fd400e25f8.png
The first Snapshot build is here! These updates will show a vertical slice of the game, one chapter at a time! The first Snapshot covers Prologue Chapter 0: "Another Dawn of Consciousness", where Cardbot finds himself in an unfamiliar setting. 

The Prologue take place in two major areas: The Shrine of Memories and the Overworld.
The Shrine of Memories is 90% complete, there are a few tweaks and mechanics to be added in the next Snapshot build. This section covers the main tutorial for the game, where you can learn the mechanics organically via exploration.

The Overworld will be a reoccurring location in the game that you can visit anytime, serving as a hub between the Dimensions and your Home. This section is about  25% percent complete as the overworld will feature new puzzles and quests that unlocks as you progress through the game. The graphics will also get overhauled in the following patches as well!

notes.title: Cardbot Update and News!
notes.content:
News
Hello Everyone! There's a new version of Cardbot available for download: v.1.2.4. 

Every Saturday, there will be a news post or a major update. This upcoming Saturday, the first major update will go live, featuring new graphics, animation and balancing/polishing. If you want to help with development, you can now submit bug requests here!

Changelog

V.1.2.3 (6/5/21)

 Polished Box Throwing Mechanic (You can now throw boxes forward without holding the forward keys.)
 Added keybind support for the box throwing mechanic.
 Removed Debug commands from the Shrine of Memories
 Re-added the Task system.
 Fixed cutscene graphics.
 Fixed bugs
 Boxes get stuck to the wall after being thrown.(B.02)
 You can run while holding boxes.(B.03)


V.1.2.4 (6/7/21)

 Added/Expanded more story for: Perel
 Fixed Misc. Bugs
